translations./garage/brief: Tires, LiDAR, and motor work together for the first time. No forklift and no extreme constraint—this run is about coordination.
translations./prediction/hint: Make a prediction. After the run, the three badges will reveal which limit mattered.
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: If LiDAR sees the obstacle too late, even strong brakes cannot recover the lost distance. Note the first detection time.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: Energy may miss the target first
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: If speed consumes too much power, the efficiency badge falls first. Read the energy meter.
translations./running/heading: Deliver the Power Module to the Signal Tower
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: All systems online. Coordinating the full run.
translations./debrief/success_summary: RO-1 recognizes every component and completes its first fully integrated run.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Find the missing badge, change the part that controls that limit, and try again.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Safety, speed, and efficiency are scored separately from this simulation run.
translations./debrief/failure_titles/timeout: Assembly run failed: time limit exceeded
